title: Asahi latest device monitoring
scope: Monitoring screen shows latest authorized Asahi telemetry with truthful missing/stale states

criteria.given: A permitted device emits a real telemetry sample
criteria.then: CPU, memory, hostname and UTC sample time equal persisted backend values

criteria.given: Telemetry fields are absent or unavailable
criteria.then: Unavailable readings display N/A and are not silently treated as zero

criteria.given: A tenant attempts access to another tenant telemetry
criteria.then: Backend denies access; UI shows no foreign sample

criteria.given: Collector is stopped and restarted in staging
criteria.then: Failures are visible, latest known sample is distinguishable from fresh data, recovery is evidenced
Table remains navigable with no inaccessible essential actions

blockers: No real Asahi device/agent telemetry E2E captured for this screen
No desktop/mobile real-browser screenshots or operator acceptance
